active_experiment.user_choice: Retire development-only calibration; use every eligible sequence to estimate fixed ratios
active_experiment.calibration: Official SAM2.1 B+ CPU FP32, same checkpoint/configuration/manifest as native CPU benchmark; unchanged native SDPA predictions checked against saved baseline hashes
active_experiment.cohort: Account for all 23 PolypGen sequence IDs; seq1/seq7 unpromptable under unchanged first-visible-mask protocol; never fabricate their scores
active_experiment.labels: Stored predicted-mask regions, Boundary IoU width 0.02; initial prompt excepted
active_experiment.ratios: Per-frame enrichment averaged within sequence/layer, then equally over four layers, then equally over eligible sequences for each region. Undefined groups excluded, with contributing sequence IDs/counts reported
active_experiment.operator: Frozen log-weight bias in all four native cross-attention layers; pointer logit bias zero; no frame selection or network architecture change
active_experiment.release_gate: Exact observer/native predictions, complete seq2/seq3 fresh-model replay, attention reconstruction, frozen parameters, source/runtime/recipe identity and confirmed online W&B delivery
active_experiment.evaluation: Same full eligible cohort, equal-sequence present-frame Dice, paired sequence bootstrap and Wilcoxon/Holm; dataset-specific adaptation, not held-out validation
active_experiment.runtime: CPU; MPS repeatability failure remains unresolved
active_experiment.older_sections: Historical records below do not override this active amendment

scope: Native memory-token three-region spatial attribution and full assignment validation; no classifier
status: Consolidated from the verified current experiments; not a new preregistration

assignment_audit.primary_label_source: predicted mask from the same native propagation frame
assignment_audit.ground_truth_role: Offline assignment audit and segmentation evaluation only; initial prompt excepted

full_assignment_validation.sequences: seq1 through seq23; all 2225 source frames
full_assignment_validation.pre_prompt_or_unpromptable_native_memory: Unavailable; never fabricate a prompt or memory tensor
full_assignment_validation.sampling: None; all frames, both available label sources, all three boundary ratios
full_assignment_validation.runtime_checks: Exact native feature/prediction replay per sequence; exact grouping reconstruction for each native frame/source/ratio; frozen parameter digest
full_assignment_validation.storage: Native vectors stored once per sequence; assignments store indices and reference memory row
full_assignment_validation.metrics: Per-sequence post-prompt GT/predicted region confusion, class IoU/precision/recall; conditioning frames excluded from agreement aggregation
full_assignment_validation.limits: Spatial attribution validation, not feature purity, attention contribution or segmentation improvement

attention_sensitivity.status: Exploratory robustness extension after inspecting primary attention results; not a new preregistration
attention_sensitivity.scope: All 2012 post-prompt targets across 21 promptable sequences; seq1/seq7 unpromptable
attention_sensitivity.weights: Same native attention weights aggregated under all six spatial-label definitions
attention_sensitivity.verification: Exact prediction hashes; reconstructed SDPA tolerance; previous predicted/0.02 attention reproduced; fresh Boundary IoU labels match saved assignments
attention_sensitivity.reporting: Per-sequence/layer/source/width counts, token fraction, native mass, conditional mean and median enrichment, ratio of mean shares, empty-frame count/fraction; equal-sequence bootstrap intervals
attention_sensitivity.ground_truth_role: External labels only; never changes memory, native attention, or decoder outputs

regional_exclusion.status: Exploratory one-step causal diagnostic, specified before exclusion outcomes; not a blinded confirmatory study
regional_exclusion.scope: All 2012 post-prompt targets across 21 promptable sequences; seq3 first as correctness gate
regional_exclusion.label_source: Predicted memory-frame binary mask; fixed Boundary IoU width 0.02
regional_exclusion.operator: Additive -infinity mask on selected spatial keys in all four native memory cross-attention layers; unchanged key layout/RoPE/pointers
regional_exclusion.random_null: Three uniform random exclusions, exactly matched within each memory frame; report their mean, never select by GT
regional_exclusion.state_control: Cached target image features, copied pre-target state containers, no-op before and after, exact active-bank byte digests and baseline propagation hashes
regional_exclusion.writeback: Disabled: counterfactual run_mem_encoder=False; never insert counterfactual outputs into memory
regional_exclusion.primary_analysis: Mean present-target Dice per sequence; region loss minus mean matched-random loss; paired Wilcoxon and Holm across three regions; 95% sequence bootstrap CI
regional_exclusion.secondary_analysis: All, absent, baseline-failure (Dice<0.5) and success target subsets; IoU and boundary F descriptive
regional_exclusion.empty_region: Exact native no-op, effect zero; report frames with region separately
regional_exclusion.limits: Deletion effects are conditional on the native bank and pointer pathway. Random controls match token count and temporal allocation, not spatial contiguity; no long-horizon or deployed-method improvement is claimed

author_baseline_benchmark.status: Exploratory author-method comparison; prior PolypGen test outcomes have been inspected
author_baseline_benchmark.pending_adapter: Efficient-SAM2 SMR-only: require real CUDA proof of active pruning with dense encoder; never substitute dense SAM2
author_baseline_benchmark.precision: Matched FP32, no autocast; an explicit adaptation where author CLI defaults to BF16
author_baseline_benchmark.prompt: One GT mask at first labeled foreground frame; no later corrections
author_baseline_benchmark.samurai_initialization_adaptation: Drop pre-prompt inputs and reindex from zero; preserve original source IDs for matched scoring
author_baseline_benchmark.model_state_isolation: Fresh author model for each sequence and smoke replay; isolated repository process
author_baseline_benchmark.full_run_gate: New serial release checks all seven conditions (including zero, regional and shuffled) on complete seq2/seq3 before six full runs. Exact repeated logits, named parameter integrity, zero/native parity and confirmed uploads mandatory. Full runs check runner/author/checkpoint/manifest/device/integration signatures
author_baseline_benchmark.scope: All 23 sequence IDs; 21 promptable scored post-prompt; seq1/seq7 N/A
author_baseline_benchmark.primary_endpoint: Equal-sequence mean present-frame Dice; same original source-frame coverage across methods
author_baseline_benchmark.comparison_statistics: Paired Wilcoxon/Holm across three author-method comparisons with SAM2; 10000 whole-sequence bootstrap confidence intervals for paired Dice differences
author_baseline_benchmark.information_access_limit: SAM2Long reports final whole-video path, which can use later evidence to revise past selections; not an online-equivalent selection-only ablation
author_baseline_benchmark.gpu_status: MPS native SAM2 failed exact repeatability including changed masks; CUDA validation pending, no CPU receipt unlocks GPU inference
author_baseline_benchmark.regional_modulation_status: Fixed [1,1,1.1] region/shuffled conditions added to new serial release; distinct from unchanged-author baselines

regional_readout.status: Exploratory fixed-rule intervention specified before its rollout outcomes; PolypGen is not an unseen test
regional_readout.weight_choice: Single modest boundary-boost hypothesis; not an optimum inferred from deletion effects, no hyperparameter sweep
regional_readout.operator: log(weight) additive bias through original PyTorch SDPA after native Q/K projections and RoPE; every key retained
regional_readout.layers: All four memory cross-attention layers only
regional_readout.frame_policy: Unchanged native SAM2 stride 1, 7 spatial memories maximum
regional_readout.pointer_limit: Pointer logits unchanged, but softmax normalization can change pointer attention mass
regional_readout.labels: Boundary IoU adapter, fixed width 0.02, stored predicted mask only; conditioning prompt excepted
regional_readout.key_alignment: Actual raw spatial memory values matched exactly to captured native encoded frames; reject unknown, ambiguous or current/future memory
regional_readout.rollout: Full propagation; native writer encodes each method's own predictions, unlike one-step deletion diagnostics
controls: shuffled region labels with per-frame counts preserved
regional_readout.shuffle: Fixed seed 20261021 hashed with source sequence and stored frame; stable across repeated reads, no GT selection
regional_readout.release_gate: Complete seq2 and seq3, repeated fresh models/states; exact native/zero parity; exact repeated logits; named parameter fingerprints; all uploads confirmed before full inference
regional_readout.integrity_diagnosis: Earlier full-run checksum failure did not reproduce in serial complete-seq2 diagnosis 1xonfgv0 (59 targets, no changed parameters). Cause unresolved; strict checks retained and named failure records added
regional_readout.precision_device: Serial matched FP32 CPU; MPS repeatability remains blocked; no CUDA equivalence asserted
regional_readout.limitations: Spatial token attribution is not exclusive vector semantics; fixed bias is project contribution/integration, not an unchanged published regional algorithm
